properties.name: 3214 Henrietta
properties.tagline: Spacious two-story home, hardwood floors, room to spread out
properties.hostNote: This one books fast on holiday weekends. Request your dates early.
properties.description:
A full two-story home with real space to breathe. Hardwood floors throughout the main level, a large living room, and a separate dining area that seats a crowd.

Upstairs has a cozy sitting nook plus the bedrooms. Cleaned top to bottom before every stay. Self check-in. Nichole is a text away if you need anything.

images.alt: Dining area with marble table and navy bench
Bedroom with green bedding and ceiling fan

properties.name: The Townhouse
properties.tagline: Elegant multi-level townhouse, styled and move-in ready
properties.hostNote: The media room upstairs is a highlight. Guests always mention it.
properties.description:
A well-appointed townhouse across multiple levels. The main floor has a bright living area with designer touches throughout. Head upstairs to the private media room: big screen, comfortable seating, set up for a night in.

Two full bathrooms, self check-in, and everything you need already stocked. Nichole takes care of the details so you don't have to.

properties.name: Beach Bound
properties.tagline: Ocean-area retreat, pool at your back door, private beach minutes away
properties.hostNote: Great spot for big groups. The sleeping setup handles the whole crew.
properties.description:
A roomy beach-area getaway built for groups. Bunk beds, trundle setup, and plenty of common space mean everyone fits comfortably.

Close to the beach and outdoor spots you came for. Cleaned top to bottom before every stay. Self check-in. Nichole is a text away if you need anything.
